leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a discriminated union type in TypeScript to define component props.
Apply the discriminated union type as the input property interface for an Angular component.
Implement conditional rendering in the component template based on the discriminator property.
Configure the component to accept and validate props using the discriminated union structure.
Bind different data structures to the component instance based on the discriminator value.
Manipulate component logic to handle the distinct cases of the union type appropriately.
